title: Useful for tracking your daily habits
body: UI is quite useful for your habits to track. Or if you want to learn or devote your time to a new hobby you can devise a weekly plan with this app. Journal part is also good for reflecting your whole day. I used to forget small details about the day before now I can keep track of them.
author: Orkun15
